# Hextris discovery and pinned source evidence

Requested source list: bobeff/open-source-games. Its fixed README at commit `3a9ab8fc892a2cdadf8989a72ba7624a11e39cec` links Games on GitHub under Other lists. The preserved `source-list-README.md` is that original source text.

The Games on GitHub list by leereilly at commit `c67976ddcf6f7aef26dc3884116205ab9ef40f74` links Hextris in Puzzle. The preserved `linked-list-README.md` is that original source text.

Upstream is https://github.com/Hextris/hextris, pinned commit `3f4847dc8fd7dab3d1c87e6324b9159d92fbd396`, tree `f6d6c8067593b1245e7c82373d877e5aa3933ebd`. Original commit/tree metadata and every retrieved text file's expected and calculated Git blob SHA1 are retained. The 24 original source/dependency/HTML/CSS/license/README files exactly match the retrieved bytes; the 14 first-party JavaScript files total 58,260 bytes.

Preflight archive originally supplied: SHA256 `66376a79205208465955c778dcfb85ac8bfc5044ec5b8354cfd371deb2f96e01`, 207,765 bytes. Only native text transforms and static inspection were used for adaptation. No original entry point, dependency or upstream build script was executed.

License evidence is the pinned README's Copyright (C) 2018 Logan Engstrom and explicit GNU GPL version 3-or-later grant. The full GPL license is preserved exactly. Four credited authors: Logan Engstrom, Garrett Finucane, Noah Moroze, Michael Yang. No externally imported game art, fonts or audio are required for the preserved Canvas game geometry.
